root_decision: T2-only staging of both devices resolves the precommit parent-publication gap. Bounded permanent retention of one committed cohort is accepted for this experimental non-unloadable candidate; no reclamation claim.
required_code_and_harness: M1 guards apply only to T2; preserve legacy T1 opens
M2 stop/sink clearing never waits for another thread or commandSleep
M4 retained child workloop only after detach; no async handleReportWithTimeAsync or getWorkLoop override
No false return or destructive cleanup after commit; preserve explicit pins and phase guards
Exact per-report lengths8/17/1752; no mode/feature/output/haptic operations
Read-only registry gate exact provider,descriptor,interface and32-byte child state; no opens
hardware_gate: SDK/KC/RAM and source reviews, separate host opt-in, fixed supervisor, paired collector, concrete packet verification, one bounded cycle and verified Linux recovery
